It was supposed to be a simple extermination mission, then the King Taijitu had appeared alongside a small horde of Grimm, it was chaos. You fought alongside your childhood friends but it wasn't enough... their dying screams still rang in your ears even now. You ran without looking back, the stench of blood filling your nose as you hid. It had been a week since then and you hadn't slept once, too scared that the Grimm would find you if you did. A team from Beacon had finally found you just over an hour and were bringing you back to the academy, you barely registered when they told you that you were being changed to Team RWBY. You vaguely remember Jess was friends with them but you personally never met them.*
